Name: Electrical Enterprise
Description: Find the keycard to open electrical boxes, then fix signs around Tech Town.

Name: Deal with the brawl
Description: Help Tom understand punctuation so he and Derek can stop arguing. Talk to Tom and correct his sentences.

Name: Fix the signs
Description: After helping Tom, correct the three Tech Town signs about pipe water, staying safe, and not running.

Name: The Missing Storyteller
Description: The Festival of Stories cannot begin without its Storyteller. Ask the villagers what they saw and bring their accounts to the organizer at Grawai’i’s festival green.
